Makeup

Makeup Application Tips

Makeup works best when it feels intentional, comfortable, and easy to remove.

Application Guide

Prepare The Skin First

Makeup sits better on skin that is clean and moisturized. A light face cream can reduce dry patches and help foundation blend more evenly.

Wait a minute before applying complexion products so skin care has time to settle.

Use Thin Layers

Foundation and concealer look more natural when applied in thin layers. Add coverage only where you want it instead of covering the entire face heavily.

Balance Color And Definition

  • Blush adds freshness after foundation.
  • Eyeshadow adds depth around the eyes.
  • Eyeliner defines the lash line.
  • Mascara darkens and lifts the look of lashes.
  • Lipstick can finish the look or become the main color statement.

Remove Makeup Gently

Leaving makeup on overnight can clog pores or irritate skin. Remove it gently, especially around the eyes, then follow with moisturizer.
